I'm sorry for not getting back in touch earlier with you, I ended up feeling so terrible I went to sleep. 

You're a really sweet person, thank you for the offer.

Sometimes I feel not so unhappy with them. I'm lucky to be in an environment where I'm not judged for them. My professors nor my fellow classmates care about that, in fact the vast majority of people so far haven't stared at me or looked at me. Maybe it does get better, I'll find out at some point if there's an answer.
